summary: Build a practical digital audit operating model with automation, analytics, AI-assisted testing, and GRC integration. Enrol today.
lede: Digital audit helps internal audit and compliance teams turn connected data, analytics, automation, and workflows into repeatable assurance and reporting. Experienced audit, risk, and compliance professionals can practise mapping risks to control data, designing automated tests and continuous monitoring, and creating exception dashboards and remediation workflows using Power BI, SQL concepts, GRC workflows, and AI-assisted testing, without requiring programming expertise.
audienceIntro: Digital audit training suits leaders and specialists responsible for assurance modernisation, compliance monitoring, risk data, or enterprise GRC technology. It is designed for experienced professionals who can contribute operational examples without requiring programming expertise.
prerequisites: You should have working experience in internal audit, compliance, enterprise risk, control testing, audit analytics, or GRC platform administration. No programming is required. Familiarity with spreadsheets and basic data concepts will help, while SQL, AI-assisted analytics, and platform integration are taught at operational application or conceptual awareness level rather than production engineering level.
